Figure 2: In DiaVLo, two parallel processes enable the classification of VLM behaviours. (Top) Scene graph generation and human curation produce SKs that are relevant for the visual and language inputs. (Bottom) VLMs provide RKs by verbalising rationales for their responses. We also compute concept-level causal estimates for deeper insights. (Middle) Finally, DiaVLo classifies model behaviours based on lexical and semantic matching.
